one_sentence: Company Brain is the memory and intelligence layer for your organization — it watches everything, understands it, stores it by type, reasons over it, and delivers the right knowledge to the right person at the right moment.
mental_model_title: Think of your organization as a person.
mental_model_paragraph: Right now, that person has amnesia. Every meeting ends, and the knowledge disappears. Every commitment made is immediately untracked. Every lesson learned is instantly forgotten. Company Brain is the brain that person needs. It remembers. It understands. It reasons. It delivers. And unlike a person, it never forgets, never gets tired, and never leaves the company.

audience_variants.executive: This isn't another dashboard to check — it's infrastructure that quietly prevents the costly stuff: repeated decisions, missed renewals, AI agents guessing instead of knowing.
audience_variants.product: When a user does something, Company Brain quietly understands it, remembers it, and surfaces it back at the moment it's useful — without them ever opening a separate app.
audience_variants.engineer: Seven canonical layers, each with a defined input, output, and owner — Capture and Understand construct reality, Memory preserves it, Intelligence reasons over it, Execution acts, Exposure delivers, Evolution refines.
audience_variants.new_hire: Think of it like seven departments, each with a specific job — together they make sure nothing the company learns ever gets lost, even after the people involved move on.
audience_variants.explorer: Capture, understand, remember, reason, act, deliver, learn — one continuous loop, and every concept you'll meet here is a piece of it.
